customManagers.description: Claude Code CLI pinned in the Dockerfile's npm install. config:recommended's dockerfile manager only reads FROM lines, so an `npm install -g pkg@version` inside a RUN is invisible to it -- this pin sat at 2.1.220 while the rest of the fleet moved to 2.1.251, and nothing would ever have opened a PR for it. The Dockerfile comment already said 'bump both together', which no bot can read. Mirrors the identical manager in Dezoxy/my-health-datas. Must be bumped together with claude_cli_version in the homelab repo.

packageRules.description: Temporary Azure migration hold: preserve the VM-tested Claude subscription CLI 2.1.284 through the cloud pilot. Remove this rule in a reviewed update only after subscription authentication and all model/translation/verification/fallback paths pass on the proposed CLI. This exact version filter intentionally suppresses newer automatic PRs during the hold; inspect npm release/security notes manually. Match only the Dockerfile custom regex manager so other npm dependencies remain unaffected.

twifork IS tracked, but gated behind the Dependency Dashboard rather than opening a PR on its own. It is a single-maintainer fork of the dead upstream twikit, it still imports as `twikit`, and it handles a live X session cookie -- see the pin's own comment in pyproject.toml. Every bump needs a supply-chain re-audit of the diff against the previous pin (no new network hosts, no new eval/exec/base64/subprocess/pickle), which no bot can assert. Excluding it entirely made those updates INVISIBLE, which is not the same as safe -- a fork going unmaintained, or shipping a fix this collector needs, would simply never surface. dependencyDashboardApproval makes Renovate report the update and wait: ticking the box is the deliberate act that starts the audit, so the bump can never arrive looking like a routine one. Remove this rule entirely to make it fully automatic.

Group workflow action bumps. The four actions in release.yml/pr-summary.yml move together and a split would mean several near-identical PRs against one file. Matches the homelab repo's own grouping of .github/workflows/**.

Group the news-site Worker toolchain. prettier and wrangler are one subtree's devDependencies with their own Node toolchain (CLAUDE.md's Conventions: npm/prettier/node --test, NOT ruff/pytest), and a bump to either is verified by the same `cd workers/news-site && npm ci && npm test` run -- so one PR, one verification.

A prettier major can reformat files it did not otherwise touch, and this subtree's test suite byte-compares rendered output against committed goldens -- so a prettier major is a review event, not a routine bump. Kept separate from the group above so its diff is read on its own.
